name: SEMICON FAB TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED
capabilities: EPCM and EPCC solutions for semiconductor facilities
india_angle: The company is focused on strengthening India's semiconductor ecosystem through local expertise development and international collaborations.
summary: Semicon Fab Technologies Private Limited provides comprehensive infrastructure solutions for semiconductor facilities, including cleanroom design, construction, and facility management. They offer end-to-end EPCM and EPCC services, ensuring compliance with global standards through strategic international partnerships.
